_note: What a new player is told (game/welcome_panel.gd, game/first_tips.gd, game/intro_tour.gd). welcome: the 'how a round works' screen shown before the traditions pick of every run but a player's first (Yusuf, 2026-10-24; the first run opens on the tour instead, 2026-10-26): title, intro, steps (when, name, text), rounds_line, earth_line, ages_line and closing (Yusuf's line: try things, a fallen village is another story lost to time; the loss screen shows lost_line). tour: the camera tour that opens a player's first run (IntroTour), shot by shot: shot (hearth, town, hero, den or map, IntroTour.shot_view says where each looks), seconds and the caption. tips: one-time highlights (Yusuf, 2026-10-26), each shown once the first time its moment comes (FirstTips.due says when), in this order when several are due: a hi-viz frame round the part of the screen it is about with the rest dimmed, and a note beside it. target is what it frames (panel: the pop-up that is up; core, begin or upgrades: those parts of the building hand; threat: the attack card; food: the food chip; map: nothing, the note sits over the map), or a list of them. A highlight closes once its moment passes (the player did the thing); ok: true gives it a Got it button too. advisor: the Elder (game/advisor.gd, Yusuf 2026-10-27), who says one line during the build phase and dawn picks only when a problem will cost the town this round and a card on screen would help: per_round = most lines a round, silence_after = times waved off (Not now) before that problem is never raised again in the run, ages = the advisor's name and colours in each age, levels = the thresholds for the Urgent only and Chatty settings (food_days and fuel_nights left, hearth_share of its max health, outmatch = the attack's power over the town's, on the attack card's scale), lines = what it says (slack_roles = the roles it speaks for when most of their last round went idle, with their plural) ({when}, {hero} and {card} are filled in).

welcome.title: You rule. You don't command.
welcome.intro: Your heroes and townsfolk think for themselves. You shape the town around them, then watch what they make of it. Each round goes like this:

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Draft one blueprint to keep for the whole run, then build what you can afford. Homes and food are always on offer. Buildings find their own spot.

steps.name: Pick a newcomer
steps.text: Choose one card: a tribesperson, a family, a hero. Your buildings decide who turns up. Everyone you take eats.

steps.name: Watch
steps.text: Townsfolk gather and craft, heroes hunt in the wilds. The third night brings the attack the card on the right warns of. Hold, and you pick a relic.

welcome.rounds_line: Survive %d rounds. Raise the next age when you're ready: it costs a lot, and pays back.
welcome.earth_line: Between rounds the ring of land past your town clicks round, so each round the attack crosses different ground: the attack card says which.
welcome.ages_line: Neolithic, then Bronze, then Medieval, at your pace
welcome.closing: Try things. If the village falls, it is one more human story lost to time.
welcome.lost_line: One more human story lost to time. Try something different next run.

first_tradition.title: Your people
first_tradition.text: Pick your people's way of life. Each brings its first blueprint and tilts which buildings and people come.

first_draft.title: Blueprints
first_draft.text: Draft a blueprint. You keep it all run and can build it every round. Point at a card for more.

first_build.title: First build
first_build.text: Build a hut. Homes and food are always here, and buildings find their own spot.

first_begin.title: Begin
first_begin.text: Build what you can afford, then press Begin round. The days play out by themselves.

first_dawn.title: First dawn
first_dawn.text: Pick a newcomer. Everyone eats, so keep an eye on food.

first_hero.title: A hero
first_hero.text: Heroes cost shells and choose their own fights, gear and beds. You can only tempt them.

first_night.title: First night
first_night.text: Space pauses. Point at anyone to see what they're up to.

first_attack.title: The attack
first_attack.text: Tonight's attack: what comes and which way. Hold, and you pick a relic.

first_relic.title: First relic
first_relic.text: Relics last the whole run. Look for ones that suit your town.

first_earth.title: The earth turned
first_earth.text: The land past your town clicked round. The attack card says which ground the attack crosses this round.

first_age.title: A new age
first_age.text: Raising an age costs a lot, but opens a new ring of plots and new buildings.

tour.text: Heroes hunt for glory and loot. You can't order them.
Back home, a handful of people around a fire.
They gather, craft and sleep on their own.
You shape the town. They do the rest.

lines.hearth: The hearth won't take another night like the last.
lines.fuel: The fire dies {when} unless someone gathers fuel.
lines.builders: Our new buildings stand half-raised. We need hands.
lines.mood: {hero} is restless and talks of leaving.
lines.outmatched: The third night's attack is stronger than all our fighters.
lines.slack: Our {people} stood idle much of last round. Give them work.
